Question 9
?

Use the Taylor series method to find a series solution about x=1, in ascending powers of (x−1) up to and including the term in (x−1)3, of the initial value problem y″=xy+y′,y(1)=1,y′(1)=2.

a
 y(x)=1+2(x−1)+56(x−1)3+⋯
b
